name: orca-marine
description: ORCA — agentic marine decision support (SIH26176, Team OCEAN-IQ).

scripts.db:reset: docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml down -v && pnpm db:up
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter @orca/web lint && python -m ruff check services packages scripts
scripts.format: python -m ruff format services packages scripts
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @orca/web typecheck && python -m mypy services/api/orca_api packages/schemas/orca_schemas services/ingest/orca_ingest services/geo/orca_geo
scripts.verify: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test
scripts.setup:py: python -m venv .venv && python -c "import subprocess,sys,os; py=os.path.join('.venv','Scripts','python.exe') if os.name=='nt' else os.path.join('.venv','bin','python'); subprocess.check_call([py,'-m','pip','install','-e','packages/schemas','-e','services/api[dev,otel]','-e','services/agents','-e','services/ingest'])"
